_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Sing for joy; the Lord has gathered his people home.
The Word became flesh, full of grace and truth.
They shall be radiant over the goodness of the Lord.
The Word became flesh, full of grace and truth.
From his fullness we have received grace upon grace.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Imagine a long road home — the scattered being gathered, the weeping turned to dancing.
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
God has gathered us from far places and turned our mourning into joy.
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
For the Word who was in the beginning has come and made his home with us.
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
And from his endless fullness we receive grace, and then more grace.
The Word became flesh, full of grace and truth!
